header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there and says so), Start
Game, the attract race, which plays by itself, about 15 s, then through the menus as a player (keys held 150 ms: A
Space, B Left Shift, Start Enter) to PRACTICE on track 1, about 25 s. The menus go by the game's own state
(0x801174B4, a bit a screen: 0x10 the main menu, 0x40 SELECT MODE, 0x80 SELECT TRACK, 0x100 the car select, 0x400000 a
race) and SELECT MODE's cursor (0x803B469F); the race's start is a need that the game is racing on the first track
(0x8014978C). PRACTICE has no time limit, so a race driven blind plays on. It is driven with the gas held and a light
weave, its waits and holds on the race clock (0x801543CC, seconds, stopped while paused), with a shot about 8 s in.
tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to two more races, for when a longer play is needed.
load: RT64: all \d+ prebuilt shaders built|once the game draws
play: new Promise((ok) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const t = setInterval(() => { let y = false; try { y = (n64r(0x801174B4) & 0x8) != 0; } catch (e) {} if (y) { clearInterval(t); ok(true); } else if (Date.now() - t0 > 12000) { clearInterval(t); let w = ''; try { w = 'state ' + n64r(0x801174B4).toString(16) + ' track ' + (n64r(0x8014978C) >>> 24) + ' mode ' + (n64r(0x803B469C) & 255) + ' clock ' + (Math.floor(new Float32Array(new Uint32Array([n64r(0x801543CC)]).buffer)[0] * 60) / 60).toFixed(1); } catch (e) { w = String(e); } console.log('[plan] attract timed out: ' + w); ok(false); } }, 100); })
